connect.title: Connect Server
connect.desc: Connect your phone to the AI gateway
connect.tailscaleDesc: Tailscale creates a secure private network across all your devices — no public IP or port forwarding needed.
connect.tailscalePrivacyNote: Tailscale establishes end-to-end encrypted tunnels. Tailscale's servers cannot read your traffic.
connect.guideStep1: Install and start Tailscale on your server (the machine running openclaw)
connect.guideStep2: Install the Tailscale app on your phone and sign in to the same account
connect.guideStep3: Check your server's Tailscale IP (100.x.x.x) in the desktop ClawNo.11 Connectors page
connect.guideStep4: Enter the IP in the URL field below, e.g. http://100.x.x.x:18789
connect.xedgeDesc: xEdge is a Tailscale-compatible mesh networking tool built for China. Log in with WeChat — no public server needed. Chinese relay nodes ensure low latency. Free tier: 20 devices, 1 GB/month.
connect.xedgeStep1: Install the xEdge client on your desktop PC (the machine running ClawNo.11) and scan the QR code with WeChat to log in
connect.xedgeStep2: Install the xEdge client on this phone (iOS / Android) and scan with the same WeChat account
connect.xedgeStep3: Your phone and PC are now on the same private network; the PC gets a 100.x.x.x IP
connect.xedgeStep4: This page auto-detects the 100.x.x.x IP (xEdge is Tailscale-compatible) and fills the URL field below
connect.xedgeTip: xEdge uses the Tailscale protocol — once connected, the IP is detected and filled automatically
connect.urlHint: Enter the gateway address (Tailscale/xEdge IP 100.x.x.x, or any accessible URL)
connect.qrInstruction: Find the QR code on the desktop Connectors page. Scan it, copy the link, tap 'Paste Link' below, then verify the PIN.
connect.qrPasteErr: Cannot recognize the connection link. Please copy the link generated by the desktop app.
connect.qrClipboardErr: Cannot read clipboard. Please paste the connection URL manually.
connect.qrExpiredErr: This connection link has expired. Please refresh the QR code on your desktop.
connect.pinInstruction: Make sure this code exactly matches the 6-character code shown on your desktop before confirming.
connect.pinExpired: Code expired. Please refresh the QR code on your desktop.
connect.testFailed: Connection failed. Check the URL and network.

security.title: Claw Guard
security.localOnlyDesc: Add a Windows Firewall rule to restrict port {{port}} to localhost only
security.panicDesc: Wipe all API keys, security settings and encrypted storage. Cannot be undone.
security.noConnections: No active connections — service may not be running
security.externalDesc: Non-local IPs are accessing your OpenClaw port. If this is unexpected, enable the firewall rule immediately.
security.noExternalDesc: All connections to the port are from localhost. No external access detected.
security.mobileNotice: Advanced features like firewall management, port monitoring, and Kill Switch are only available on the desktop ClawNo.11. This page provides read-only access to security event logs.
security.panicConfirm:
Destroy all local data?

This will wipe all API Key configurations and security settings. This action cannot be undone.
security.noInstanceWarning: No online instance found — scan results target the fallback port {{port}} and may not reflect your actual service.
security.killSwitchDesc: Immediately cut all AI outbound access and suspend the service. Data is preserved and can be restored.
security.killSwitchDone: Emergency offline activated — service paused, firewall locked, data intact.
security.killSwitchRestoreDone: Service restored and firewall rules removed.
security.toolPermsDesc: Control what system resources the AI Agent can access
security.execToolDesc: AI uses the exec tool to run system commands (highest risk)

execModeHint.deny: AI cannot run any shell commands. Most secure.
execModeHint.ask: Each exec requires manual confirmation in the terminal/console.
execModeHint.allow: ⚠️ AI can run any system command without restriction. Use only in controlled environments.

security.allowlistDesc: In 'Require Approval' mode, allowlisted commands run without prompting
security.injectionDesc: Scans outgoing messages for potential injection attack patterns before sending
security.injectionWarnDetail: This message contains patterns that may attempt to bypass AI safety settings. Send anyway?
security.netAccessDesc: Choose which devices are allowed to reach the OpenClaw gateway port

netAccessModeDesc.off: Any device on any network can connect. Suitable for local-only setups with firewall already enforced.
netAccessModeDesc.subnet: Only devices on the same WiFi/LAN as this machine (e.g. {{subnet}}) can connect. Mobile data or other networks are automatically blocked by your router.
netAccessModeDesc.tailscale: Only devices in your Tailscale network (100.64.0.0/10) can connect. Stable across WiFi / mobile data / travel — IP never changes.

security.netAccessTailscaleTip: No Tailscale yet? → Install it in
security.netAccessNoLan: No LAN connection detected (WiFi / Ethernet required for subnet mode)
security.ipWhitelistDesc: Grant specific devices access (phone / tablet / remote PC) without opening the port globally
security.ipWhitelistHint: Devices must be on the same WiFi or connected via VPN. Re-add if the IP changes (DHCP).
security.ipFoundEmpty: No other devices found (try pinging this machine from your phone)
security.scoreBreakdownHint: Click the ring to view breakdown
